title: Batch 3: defer hidden chat code beyond initial loading
summary: Candidate separates the hidden chat widget into an asynchronous client chunk, scheduled after load at idle or immediately on scroll. Fonts and storefront styling are unchanged. Validation and paired measurement pending.

changes.detail: DeferredChatWidget loads existing chat on idle after page load (1500ms timeout; timer fallback), or early scroll.
Root layout uses deferred entry; chat initializes scroll visibility at mount to support restored/early scroll. Session, messages, credentials, checkout and database behavior untouched.
